title: The Hermit Hoard
logline: A paranoid hermit hires a pilot to physically drag their entire hoard of junk away before a greedy salvager can steal it during a gravity tide.

roles.description: Filthy, territorial, deeply emotionally attached to literal garbage.
Smug, wealthy, constantly evaluating the price of everything.
A small rock absolutely covered in rusting metal and old ship parts.
A massive industrial ship with terrifyingly large grappling claws.
A ruthless union of scrap dealers and claim jumpers.

public_situation: The {role:scavenger_coalition} has declared the {role:hermit_asteroid} legally abandoned, opening it for salvage.
private_truth: The hermit is very much alive and living inside the junk pile, and the "junk" actually hides a priceless colonial-era reactor core.

beats.public_change: The salvage barge arrives in the system and begins powering up its tractor beams.

missions.reason: The hermit begs the pilot to meet them at the asteroid's hidden dock and collect their most prized possession: a completely worthless ceramic mug.
missions.private_fact: The hermit values the sentimental coffee mug above the priceless colonial reactor core humming quietly in the asteroid's basement.

beats.public_change: Massive gravity tides begin to pull the asteroid apart.

missions.reason: The salvager hires the pilot to buy and deliver heavy explosive charges to crack the asteroid open faster.
missions.private_fact: The explosives will likely kill the hermit in the process.

beats.public_change: The salvager moves in to claim the reactor core.

missions.reason: The hermit pays the pilot their life savings (which is mostly copper wire) to destroy the salvage barge and protect their home.
missions.private_fact: The salvager hails the pilot, offering them half the profits from the reactor if they stand down.

player_choice.prompt: The salvage barge is vulnerable. The salvager is offering millions for the reactor. The hermit just wants their junk.

options.label: Protect the hermit and destroy the barge
Take the deal and let the hermit lose everything

resolutions.summary: The barge is destroyed. The hermit is thrilled to keep their trash pile, completely ignoring the priceless reactor. The pilot is paid in copper wire.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up an industrial salvage barge to protect a crazy hermit's pile of garbage.

resolutions.summary: The salvager takes the reactor. The hermit is evicted and left homeless. The pilot gets rich, but the coalition marks them as a ruthless mercenary.
The salvager detonates the charges, cracking the asteroid. The hermit is violently evicted by security bots, and the salvager claims the reactor.

loose_threads.detail: The colonial reactor actually belongs to the planetary governor, who lost it in a drunken bet decades ago.
The salvager brags that they bribed the coalition to falsely declare the asteroid abandoned.

radio_hooks: {role:scavenger_coalition} opens new sector for aggressive salvage operations.
Rumors of a hidden treasure in a pile of space junk.

voice_direction.paranoid_hermit: Gravelly, suspicious, talks to inanimate objects.
voice_direction.greedy_salvager: Oily, confident, speaks far too loudly.
